comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by partner universities; it doesn't operate schools or enroll students itself.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit nursing and allied health colleges funded by tuition and student aid, matching Rasmussen's healthcare education, though smaller and regional.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: For-profit, mostly online adult degree universities funded by Title IV, with health sciences education, same business as APEI.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults, with military and employer tuition channels and Title IV funding, like APEI.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schools funded by public school per-pupil funding and curriculum sales, not postsecondary adult degrees.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: For-profit postsecondary campus-based career training funded by Title IV and GI Bill, similar to APEI's career education, though trades-focused.
